title: Taiwanese prosecutors file additional indictments against Tokyo Electron's Taiwan unit and three other defendants over the alleged theft of TSMC trade secrets (Wen-Yee Lee/Reuters)
summary: Wen-Yee Lee / Reuters: Taiwanese prosecutors file additional indictments against Tokyo Electron's Taiwan unit and three other defendants over the alleged theft of TSMC trade secrets — Taiwanese prosecutors said on Monday they had filed additional indictments against the Taiwan unit of Tokyo Electron (8035.T) …
